x: Mayers, our coloured sprinter, win the 100 yards in 10.4 secs., and he was also second to A. Dick, the Oxford University runner, in the 220.
At the Inter-Varsity Sports Meeting at the White City on 14th March, Alan Sexton, our quarter-mile champion, was second in the 440 yards to A.

Arthur Wint continued to dominate the scene in the 400m although Les Lewis, Alan Dick and Terry Higgins were beginning to show prominently. Our 800 metre competition was still commanded by Arthur Wint unless challenged by Roger Bannister and the two other performers Frank Evans and Albert Webster.
